title: Battery Over-Temperature
shortDescription: ProCORE/CoolPack battery too hot to discharge.
fullDescription: One steady red LED on Bosch 18V Professional tools indicates the battery has exceeded 70 C. Tool inhibits operation until cool.

causes.cause: Heavy use of small Ah pack

fixSteps.title: Cool the pack
fixSteps.instruction: Remove pack, leave in shade 20-30 minutes.

title: Tool Over-Temperature
shortDescription: Tool electronics or motor temperature limit reached.
fullDescription: A flashing red LED indicates the tool's NTC sensor read above 80 C in the motor or driver stage. Cool down required.

fixSteps.title: Cool tool
fixSteps.instruction: Run with no-load for 30s then wait 10 min.

title: Over-Current Cutoff
shortDescription: Bit jam or stall protection tripped.
fullDescription: Two red LEDs indicate the electronic motor protection has cut power because of a stall or excess current draw.

fixSteps.title: Free bit
fixSteps.instruction: Remove from material, release trigger, restart.

title: KickBack Control Trigger
shortDescription: Sudden rotation detected; tool shut off.
fullDescription: Bosch KickBack Control sensors detected sudden tool rotation and instantly cut motor to prevent injury.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Release trigger, ensure handle attached, restart.

title: Battery Discharged
shortDescription: Below 16V cutoff threshold.
fullDescription: Battery state of charge LEDs all off; tool inhibited to protect cells from over-discharge.

title: Connectivity Module Fault
shortDescription: Bosch Toolbox cannot pair with tool.
fullDescription: Connected tools (GCY 42 module) report ER02 in the Bosch Toolbox app when the BLE module fails to advertise.

title: Charger Pack Temperature Hold
shortDescription: Charger waiting for pack to reach 0-45 C.
fullDescription: GAL/GAX chargers blink red while pack temp is out of range; charging starts automatically when in range.

fixSteps.title: Wait
fixSteps.instruction: Leave pack on charger; it self-resumes.

title: Charger Detected Defective Pack
shortDescription: Cell imbalance or BMS lockout.
fullDescription: Fast red flashing on Bosch charger means the pack reports a fault that cannot be cleared by waiting.

title: Drop Control Triggered
shortDescription: Tool dropped; safety lockout active.
fullDescription: Bosch Drop Control accelerometer detected free-fall and locked out the tool. Reinsert battery to clear.
symptoms: Tool will not run after drop

fixSteps.title: Reinsert battery
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and reinsert pack to reset.

title: Motor Sensor Communication Loss
shortDescription: Hall effect line broken to motor.
fullDescription: Alternating red/green LED indicates the controller lost the rotor-position signal during operation.

faq.a: Yes if Pro tool under warranty.

title: GBA/ProCORE fault
shortDescription: GBA/ProCORE battery fault.
fullDescription: GBA/ProCORE battery fault. Common indication on Bosch Tools cordless tools. Resolve by power-cycling, checking battery contacts, or contacting service.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Clean battery and tool contacts with dry cloth.

fixSteps.title: Test on another tool
fixSteps.instruction: Try battery in another compatible tool to isolate.

whenToCallPro: If reset doesn't fix or BMS continues to trip, warranty service may be needed.
videoSearchQuery: Bosch Tools gba-procore-fault cordless tool fix

faq.a: Maybe — try another known-good battery first.
Most cordless platforms have 3-year battery warranty.
